steps.reason: described precisely, change becomes motion through a space of possible states
an oscillator's orbit in phase space is the motion a vibrating source passes on to the medium around it
a steady vibration repeats at a regular period, the kind of regularity a clock counts, from pendulums to quartz
the cycles that keep time also organize music, where recurring pulses become a beat
keeping a shared beat is a repeated exchange between people, the kind that can strengthen the links between two groups
after the scientific picture of what exists comes the question of why mathematics describes it so well
mathematics as reality and information as reality are rival readings of that success, and they claim different things
the amplitudes and phases of a quantum state return in the mandala's waves and symmetry, now as a symbol rather than a model
the mandala's symbolic interconnection is carried to a single source, a metaphysical view rather than cosmology
a waveform taken apart into frequencies is also a signal, which noise can blur without changing its source
a code is how a signal survives noise: parity bits let a receiver find and correct an error
a code fixes what each symbol stands for, but meaning depends on context, which no code carries by itself
if meaning shifts with context, one signal can be read in several coherent ways
understanding starts when different interpretations find shared reference points, without having to become the same

journeys.title: from simple rules to unexpected play

steps.reason: the rules of a game and the laws of motion are both short statements that decide which paths are possible
from one system following a law to many agents following local rules, where coherent group motion appears
a flock's order arises without anyone choosing it, while strategy adds players who choose, and an equilibrium is where their choices balance
played many times by many players, contributing to a shared pool can become a stable strategy or a fragile one
rules that let players build together can also build worlds, as a few symbols combine recursively into a place to play in
diffusion spreads particles out, and shannon entropy measures how spread out a distribution of symbols is: related in some settings, not the same quantity
entropy quantifies uncertainty, and in a chaotic system a tiny uncertainty about the start grows until two nearby paths look unrelated
one pair of separating paths becomes an ensemble, and its widening cloud marks how far ahead a forecast can reach
with prediction limited to a horizon, a speculative question follows: whether time's direction is fundamental at all, or a feature of how configurations relate

journeys.title: from improvisation to a social world

steps.reason: improvised music moves through emotions without a fixed path, as imaginative play invents its world as it goes
role-play makes inner states visible through symbols and actions, which is where expression begins
an expression made public invites a response, and repeated exchanges build connections
connections that keep being renewed resemble an open game, with no final victory and more possible paths
